verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses Hilbert series of GL_r × torus orbit closures of matrices and matroid invariants, with 'hook-shaped Schur functions' coefficients — it does not address the symmetric-group trivial-isotype mass of permanent/padded-determinant coefficient vectors or determinantal complexity bounds.

verdicts.title: Bounds on Determinantal Complexity of Two Types of Generalized Permanents
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We define two new families of polynomials that generalize permanents and prove upper and lower bounds on their determinantal complexities comparable to the known bounds for permanents. One of these families is obtained by replacing permutations by signed permutations, and the other by replacing permutations by surjective functions with preimages of prescribed sizes.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract addresses determinantal complexity bounds for generalizations of the permanent (signed permutations, surjective functions), with no mention of Specht/trivial-isotype decompositions or the permutation-diagonal coefficient invariant ρ(f) that the conjecture concerns.
